title: Update site contact email to shreefireworks@yahoo.com across all UI and mailto links

requirements.text: Update the site contact email address to "shreefireworks@yahoo.com" everywhere it appears in the frontend, including displayed text, mailto links, and any SEO/meta copy that mentions the email.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/content/siteContent.ts, siteContent.contact.email is exactly "shreefireworks@yahoo.com" (replacing the current incorrect value).

All mailto links that currently use "shreefirebase@yahoo.com" are updated to "mailto:shreefireworks@yahoo.com" (including frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx and frontend/src/components/CtaBar.tsx).
Any user-visible text that currently shows "shreefirebase@yahoo.com" is updated to "shreefireworks@yahoo.com" (including the footer email label).
In frontend/src/content/seoMeta.ts, the contact page description no longer references "shreefirebase@yahoo.com" and instead references "shreefireworks@yahoo.com".
The Contact page email card continues to render the updated email via siteContent.contact.email and opens the correct email address when clicked.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Changing phone numbers, address, or other contact details.
Adding new pages or changing the contact form submission behavior/backend inquiry storage.
